reason: Anyorder/number and repeat when itemcostreadyundamaged, no fixedsequence. Same named actions retain their normal requirements; no volunteered waiver. RangerHideout contextual per fixedpolicy.

question.question: How many Daylight actions may the Vagabond take, must the action types follow a fixed order, and may the same action type be repeated?

expected.expected_answer: The Vagabond may take Daylight actions in any order and number, repeating or interleaving action types as desired, provided each action can pay its item costs and meet its other requirements. There is no separate fixed action-count allowance. Ranger Hideout still immediately ends Daylight as specified.

source_passages.quotation: **Daylight:** Any order/number, as ready undamaged items permit:

answer.ruling: The Vagabond may take Daylight actions in any order and number, as its ready undamaged items permit. There is no fixed action-type sequence; the same type may be repeated if the required items remain ready and undamaged.
